apply.meta.title: How applying works: entrance routes & application guide — SRM Compass
apply.meta.description: Entrance exam routes, counselling steps and helpline contacts as published in SRM's 2026-27 brochure.
apply.heading: How applying works
apply.lead: A guide built from SRM's published pages and 2026-27 brochure.
apply.steps.heading: Apply once, choose later (B.Tech)
apply.steps.description: For B.Tech admission, one application covers the campuses listed on SRM's form, including these six. You do not lock in your campus or specialisation on the form.
apply.steps.step1_text: Verify that you meet the 60% aggregate threshold across Physics, Mathematics, and one qualifying subject, and the age requirement (16y 6m by 31 July).
apply.steps.step2_text: Register for SRMJEEE (B.Tech) on SRM’s official portal. The branch preference collected on the application form is used for statistics only.
apply.steps.step3_title: Choose campus and branch at counselling
apply.steps.step3_text: After exam ranks are published, you select your campus, programme, and specialisation during counselling.
apply.routes.heading: Which route fits you?
apply.routes.intro: Select your discipline below to check the entrance exam, application steps, helpline contact, and direct portal link as published in the SRM 2026-27 admission brochure.
apply.routes.noscript_note: All 8 entrance routes are listed above in expandable sections.
apply.actions.student_stories: See what students built at SRM
eligibility.meta.title: Eligibility Criteria & Checker — SRM Compass
eligibility.meta.description: Check your B.Tech admission eligibility against SRM's official 2026-27 rules. 100% private in-browser evaluation with source citations.
eligibility.heading: Eligibility
eligibility.lede: Official admission requirements for B.Tech programmes across SRMIST campuses for the 2026–2027 academic cycle (for the 2026-27 cycle; SRM may revise for 2027 entry).
eligibility.checker.title: Check your B.Tech eligibility
eligibility.checker.description: Check your marks, age, subjects, and board against SRM’s published 2026–2027 minimum admission criteria for the 2026-27 cycle; SRM may revise for 2027 entry.
eligibility.checker.privacy_text: Nothing is sent, stored or put in the URL. All evaluation runs 100% locally in your browser.
eligibility.checker.noscript_title: JavaScript is required for interactive eligibility checking.
eligibility.checker.noscript_text: SRM Compass evaluates marks and date of birth 100% locally in your browser. This form uses {method} to ensure that student marks and dates of birth can never be leaked into the URL. Submit is disabled until JavaScript initialises. Please review the complete 2026–2027 rule breakdown below.
eligibility.form.board_isce: ISCE / ISC (Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations)
eligibility.form.exam_year_hint: Choice of 2026 or 2027 admission exam cycle
eligibility.form.dob_hint: Must be at least 16y 6m on 31 July of exam year
eligibility.form.group_general: General (CSE, EEE, ECE, Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace, AI, etc.)
eligibility.form.general_subjects_desc: Physics and Mathematics are mandatory for General B.Tech programmes. Unticked means you do not meet minimum criteria.
eligibility.form.combo_pcb: PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology / Biotechnology) — additional 4-credit course in Mathematics required
eligibility.form.combo_z: Z (Botany or Zoology) — additional 4-credit course in Mathematics required
eligibility.form.biotech_hint: Candidates without 10+2 Mathematics must take an additional 4-credit course in Mathematics in year 1.
eligibility.form.aggregate_label: Aggregate percent across the 3 subjects (0 to 100, one decimal at most)
eligibility.form.aggregate_hint: Published minimum threshold is at least 60.0% aggregate across the 3 subjects. Evaluated without rounding.
eligibility.conflict.title: Source conflict.
eligibility.conflict.body: We show SRM’s 2026-27 rule (for the 2026-27 cycle; SRM may revise for 2027 entry): at least 60% aggregate in Physics, Mathematics and one more qualifying subject. Biotechnology and biomedical programmes need 60% in PCM, PMB, PCB or similar combinations. In {conflictCount} of the {totalOfferings} offerings in SRM’s fee table, older text still says 50% and cites SRMJEEE (UG) 2022.
eligibility.breakdown.heading: 2026–2027 Rule Breakdown (for the 2026-27 cycle; SRM may revise for 2027 entry)
eligibility.breakdown.rule3_text: Resident Indian. Should have attained the age of 16 years and 6 months on the 31st July of the calendar year in which the 12th Board examination is held.
eligibility.breakdown.rule4_text: Admission is through the national-level entrance exam SRMJEEE (UG).
eligibility.rules.general: Applicant should have passed in Higher secondary examination (10 +2 pattern) or appearing in Higher Secondary examination in the current academic year with a minimum of 60% aggregate (3 subjects) in Physics (mandatory), Mathematics (mandatory) and at least one of Chemistry / Biotechnology / Biology / Computer Science / Information Technology / Informatics Practices / Engineering Graphics / Botany and Zoology as major subjects in regular subjects in regular stream from any board within India, CBSE, ISCE, IB or NIOS.
eligibility.rules.biotech: For B.Tech Programs offered by the Department of Biotechnology, Department of Genetic Engineering and Department of Biomedical Engineering – minimum 60% aggregate in PCM / PMB/PCB/PCB or Z (Botany or Zoology). Students admitted for the above programs and who have not studied Mathematics as one of the major subjects in 10+2 must undertake an additional 4-credit course in Mathematics during the First Year of B.Tech.
eligibility.rules.capture_note: Text re-read on SRM's page 31 Oct 2026
eligibility.notes.chemistry_bridge: Students who have not studied Chemistry in +2 level should undergo a bridge course in Chemistry in the first year.
eligibility.notes.nios_schooling: Students who have completed 10+2 under NIOS must have completed the 10th standard from regular schooling or vice versa.
eligibility.validation.aggregate_format: Aggregate percentage must contain only digits with an optional single decimal point.
eligibility.rules.age: Age: at least 16 years and 6 months on 31st July of the exam year.
eligibility.rules.math_note: Students who have not studied Mathematics in 10+2 must undertake an additional 4-credit course in Mathematics during the first year.
eligibility.rules.disclaimer: This checks minimum marks and age only; admission is through SRMJEEE (UG); SRM decides.
eligibility.rules.privacy_notice: Privacy: Nothing is sent, stored or put in the URL. All evaluation runs 100% locally in your browser.
eligibility.validation.aggregate_invalid: Aggregate percentage must be a valid finite number.
eligibility.validation.aggregate_range: Aggregate percentage must be between 0.0 and 100.0.
eligibility.validation.dob_invalid: Date of birth must be a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
eligibility.result.error_intro: Eligibility cannot be evaluated until the following field errors are corrected:
eligibility.result.check_srm_nri: Check SRM's page: Non-Resident Indian (NRI), PIO, OCI, and international candidates must apply through SRM's international admissions portal: {url}.
eligibility.result.check_srm_board: Check SRM's page: Candidates qualifying from {board} should consult SRM's own sections on https://www.srmist.edu.in/admission-india/engineering/ for admission requirements and subject equivalences.
eligibility.result.fail_marks: Aggregate percentage: {percent}% is below SRM's minimum required threshold of 60.0% across the 3 qualifying subjects.
eligibility.result.fail_age: Age requirement: Applicant must be at least 16 years 6 months on 31 July {examYear}. For the {examYear} exam year, date of birth must be on or before {cutoffDate} (entered: {dob}).
eligibility.result.fail_mandatory_subjec: Mandatory subjects: {subjects} is mandatory for General engineering programmes.
eligibility.result.does_not_meet_headlin: You do not meet these criteria
eligibility.result.meets_headline: You meet SRM's published minimum criteria
eligibility.result.meets_reason: Your aggregate score of {percent}%, qualifying board ({board}), status ({status}), and date of birth satisfy SRM's published minimum thresholds.
eligibility.conflict.details: 2026-27 criteria section: 60% aggregate (3 subjects). Fee table eligibility column: 50% aggregate, 2022 wording. Both are on {link}. Confirm on SRM’s page before you rely on either.
